source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hypothetical extremes and noisy emptiness.
key_decisions.before: If I speak in the tongues of mortals and of angels but do not have love, I have become a sounding gong or a clanging cymbal.
key_decisions.after: If I speak in the tongues of humans and of angels but do not have love, I have become a resounding gong or a clashing cymbal.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If I speak in the tongues of mortals and of angels but do not have love, I have become a sounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated all and love's decisive absence.
key_decisions.before: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
key_decisions.after: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains but do not have love, I am nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows pinned boast variant and keeps total self-giving without benefit.
key_decisions.before: And if I give away all I possess, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
key_decisions.after: And if I give away all my possessions, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if I give away all I possess, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps relational behaviors and accounting image.
key_decisions.before: It is not rude. It does not seek its own. It is not easily provoked. It does not keep account of wrong.
key_decisions.after: It does not behave dishonorably, does not seek its own way, is not easily provoked, and does not keep an account of wrong.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is not rude. It does not seek its own. It is not easily provoked. It does not keep account of wrong.

key_decisions.before: It bears everything, believes everything, hopes everything, endures everything.
key_decisions.after: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves love's permanence and gifts' cessation.
key_decisions.before: Love never falls. But where there are prophecies, they will be set aside; where there are tongues, they will cease; where there is knowledge, it will be set aside.
key_decisions.after: Love never fails. But prophecies will be brought to an end, tongues will cease, and knowledge will be brought to an end.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Love never falls. But where there are prophecies, they will be set aside; where there are tongues, they will cease; where there is knowledge, it will be set aside.

key_decisions.rationale: Uses completeness without prematurely defining the referent.
key_decisions.before: but when the complete comes, the partial will be set aside.
key_decisions.after: but when completeness comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but when the complete comes, the partial will be set aside.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves ancient mirror obscurity and knowing reciprocity.
key_decisions.before: For now we see through a mirror, in a riddle; but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I will know fully, even as I have been fully known.
key_decisions.after: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I will know fully, just as I have been fully known.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For now we see through a mirror, in a riddle; but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I have been fully known.
